maya_csm: Heads-up: AuroCore renewal in ~7 weeks. Usage steady but they reported cost creep and periodic latency tails. Proposing a short 48h experiment: 10% traffic to an int8 quant variant + route non-interactive jobs to m-small to free headroom. Need quick eng + SRE sign-off and customer ok.

derek_cs: They'll want an estimated savings percent and exact rollback SLA. Can we give numbers they can include in the renewal packet?

maya_csm: Baseline last 72h: p50 150ms, p95 430ms, tail spikes ~1.1s when concurrency >85. Unit cost ~ $405 / 1M tokens. Favored estimate: int8 -> ~30-36% compute savings; median latency +10-20ms but throughput rise should cut queueing and may lower tail.

anu_engineer: I can prepare m-aurocore-v2:int8 artifact and run regression on a 200-example customer eval set. Recommend 48h canary at 10% with automated similarity + error rate checks and manual spot reviews. Regression threshold: pass_rate >= 0.9, max_delta <= 0.02.

cal_sre: From infra: bump min replicas for canary pool, enable per-route prefix caching for repeated assistant contexts, and route embeddings/bulk indexing to m-small. I'll add alert: p95 > 750ms OR error_rate > 0.5% triggers rollback.

anu_engineer: Canary deploy command (example): ```bash
redwoodctl deploy --customer aurocore --model m-aurocore-v2:int8 --route canary --weight 0.10 --tag auro-canary-2026-03
```

deploy-bot: Canary queued for aurocore (id: ac-canary-42). Will roll out to us-west-2 at weight 10% pending approvals.

maya_csm: I'll request a 200-sample eval set and send the customer note: "We propose a 48-hour 10% canary with a quantized model to evaluate cost savings (~30-35%). We'll monitor automatically and roll back within 30 minutes if thresholds breach." Thoughts?

derek_cs: Good. Add that we'll include sample diffs and attach results to the renewal playbook. I'll log the plan in Gainsight.

anu_engineer: Quick local run on 200 samples: pass 186/200, avg_similarity 0.981, max_delta 0.013 1 small formatting diffs on tables. Will attach diffs to ticket AC-721.

cal_sre: Alerts and autoscale bump set. I'll monitor dashboards during the canary window.

maya_csm: Actions: anu -> full regression + upload diffs (ETA 8h). cal -> confirm infra obs (ETA 2h). derek -> Gainsight + customer outreach (ETA 4h). Reconvene 24h after start. Thanks team :pray:
